blurb: Guests fish for lake trout, salmon, walleye, brown trout, and steelhead on Lake Superior and the St. Louis River. Trips are on a 31 foot Tiara Yacht equipped with top fishing and safety gear. The captain is US Coast Guard Licensed and MN and WI Licensed Guide with over 15 years experience.
extraNote: Deposit required to complete booking · Email confirmation sent with booking information · Captain may suggest adding an hour for travel to fish if needed at $100 per hour · Duluth port
